question: Estimate the daily consumption of bread (pav, sliced loaf, buns) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All baked bread products: pav, sliced bread, kulcha, bun, sandwich loaves? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × bread-eating share × consumption per eater.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bread-eating population in India (regular consumers): ~25-30% = ~360-430M (skewed to urban + Maharashtra/Goa pav, South India sandwich, North urban breakfast).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus pav (Mumbai-Maharashtra): ~3-4 crore pav/day in Maharashtra alone.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~25-30% = ~360-430M (skewed to urban + Maharashtra/Goa pav, South India sandwich, North urban breakfast).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, daily eaters (loaf or pav)

calculationFlow: Bread-eating population in India (regular consumers): ~25-30% = ~360-430M (skewed to urban + Maharashtra/Goa pav, South India sandwich, North urban breakfast).
Plus pav (Mumbai-Maharashtra): ~3-4 crore pav/day in Maharashtra alone.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Plus pav (Mumbai-Maharashtra): ~3-4 crore pav/day in Maharashtra alone.
